name: BulkBite Operations
purpose: Provide a self-explanatory BulkBite stock dashboard with a restrained charcoal-and-muted-orange shell around calm neutral operational work surfaces

composition.hierarchy: Use a compact page title, one-sentence purpose, visible workflow stages, one main work area, and a separate review or posting boundary.
composition.negativeSpace: Use calm dashboard spacing. Group each decision with its evidence and next action while keeping repeated rows efficient.
composition.geometry: Use a compact collapsible soft-charcoal setup rail, one calm muted-orange top area, separated horizontal workflow navigation, neutral work surfaces, soft borders, and generous but consistent rounding.
composition.density: Keep forms and tables efficient without making the task feel cramped. Touch targets remain at least 44 pixels high.
composition.lighting: Use restrained surface elevation and tonal separation. No decorative lighting, gradients, textures, or atmospheric effects.

componentTreatment.buttons: Use ordinary Frappe UI button sizing with explicit labels and rounded geometry. Workflow tabs use separated low-contrast segments with a light active surface and dark indicator. Refresh has a fixed footprint and a strictly bounded loading indicator.
componentTreatment.forms: Frappe UI behavior with persistent labels, 44 pixel targets, consistent internal padding, tinted field surfaces, visible units, direct help, explicit errors, and raised neutral popovers.
componentTreatment.cards: Use tinted work surfaces with soft borders and 14 to 16 pixel rounding. Reserve the brightest surface for the current decision or open popover.

primitiveTreatment.rule: Keep solid-field available as the required fallback primitive, but do not mount visual primitives in ordinary operations views. Structure comes from flow, spacing, semantic surface levels, and soft borders.

recipeTreatment.rule: Keep precision-frame available for an exceptional evidence boundary, but do not apply decorative recipes to ordinary operational pages.

blockTreatment.rhythm: Orient the user, show numbered stages, present one current work area, then expose review and posting as an explicit final boundary.

motion.character: Still by default. Use only provider-native state transitions required for control feedback.
motion.reduced: Render final state immediately; no meaning or hierarchy depends on movement.

responsive: Protect state, units, evidence, and action order. Collapse columns before reducing targets or hiding labels.
prohibitions: Use muted orange only for the top shell area, active workflow emphasis, warnings that require it, and the primary action. Routine keyboard focus uses neutral high contrast.
Do not use Anton, campaign slogans, oversized all-caps headings, black feature panels, or poster composition in the dashboard.
Do not mount decorative primitives, recipes, or entrance experiences in operational views.
Do not use gradients, glossy surfaces, bright campaign-orange fields, non-collapsible dominant sidebars, or decorative panels.
Do not use white, warm paper, paper shadow, or another near-white value for the sidebar or top shell area.
Do not make the canvas, sidebar, work panels, fields, and popovers the same white surface.
Do not place raw controls in pages when a selected System owner exists.
Do not hide posting, reconciliation, or review state behind menus.
Do not use accounting dimensions in worker entry workflows.

lifecycle.promotion: Keep this theme project-owned until another operations app proves that its BulkBite-specific navigation and workflow treatment transfers without losing brand meaning.
lifecycle.demotion: Move the theme back to candidate if its approved BulkBite composition, responsive behavior, or fresh-consumer proof no longer passes.

lifecycleProof.brandMeaning: The charcoal navigation, muted orange workflow header, neutral work surfaces, and restrained motion preserve BulkBite's practical kitchen-operations identity.
lifecycleProof.crossProjectUse: Project-owned by design. Reusable System component behavior is shared through Dysium, while BulkBite-specific brand treatment stays local until a second operations project proves transferability.
lifecycleProof.responsive: The accepted desktop shell and mobile operator shell use the same semantic tokens, preserve labeled controls, and keep 44 pixel interaction targets without replacing the workflow owners.
lifecycleProof.freshConsumer: The BulkBite Vue application consumes the approved theme through generated Dysium tokens and public System exports, with project audit and production builds as the executable consumer proof.
